blue_skies.everbright.nature_dungeon.lor: I managed to stumble upon a giant green pyramid structure in the Snow Covered Pines. After entering, I was greeted by many of its inhabitants. They seemed to be golems constructed entirely of the structure’s stone, held together with Starlit Vines. As I was nearing the top of the dungeon, I started to realize that the build quality had been getting better the whole time! The bottom floors seemed to be very aged, and weathered away, while the upper floors were in almost pristine condition. At the top, I found four keys scattered across the floor in front of a Keystone similar to what I saw in the Blinding Dungeon. However, due to some rumors I’ve heard, I likely won’t be using it myself. I’ve decided to call this giant structure the §oNature §oDungeon§r.
blue_skies.everdawn.poison_dungeon.lore: During my exploration of the Sunset Maple Forest, I was able to locate a strange looking tree. It was covered in webs, and to my surprise, inside of it was a giant spider nest! This place is home to many Venom Spiders. I was also surprised to see that the Overworld’s Cave Spider made its way into this nest. Unlike the Blinding Dungeon, I couldn't find any keys as I explored the floors. I can hear what sounds like loud hissing through the halls of this place, I can’t imagine what’s at the end... I think I’ll call this place the §oPoison Dungeon§r.
